title.zh: pentaho/hv-uikit-react · 装一套 React 组件

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Hitachi Vantara 的 React UI 组件库仓库，给做企业级产品的团队用。README 把它写成 Open-source React UI library to build high-quality digital products，多主题与可访问性是两条主线。
description.en: Hitachi Vantara 的 React UI 组件库仓库，给做企业级产品的团队用。README 把它写成 Open-source React UI library to build high-quality digital products，多主题与可访问性是两条主线。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by pentaho/hv-uikit-react (https://github.com/pentaho/hv-uikit-react).
Technology stack: react, typescript, css.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏是标准 GitHub 仓库页，About 写着 UI library to build high-quality digital products，主页指向 pentaho.github.io/uikit-docs/master/，标签挂着 design-systems / react / typescript。README 开头一节叫 Why UI Kit，四条卖点里 Seamless Multi-Theming 和 Accessibility-Centric 最具体。根目录能看到 .storybook、packages、apps、examples 四层并列，说明文档场和组件包是同仓维护的。右侧 Releases 已经滚到 v7.0.0，累计 2,297 个版本、50 位贡献者，许可证标的是 Apache-2.0。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: README 文件区的许可证一行写 Apache-2.0 license，右侧 About 面板同样标注
